views.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; hybrid rule-based and learned systems get the worst of both.
views.zh: 纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达；规则与学习的混合系统往往两头不讨好。

views.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute and world models; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）一个可泛化的 AI 司机需要海量数据、算力和世界模型；基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

views.en: The future is mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors, not retrofits; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis short and medium term.
views.zh: 未来是内置传感器的量产车，而非改装车；中短期内消费级车辆将比 Robotaxi 更具规模优势。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treat current models well because future models learn from how we treat them; model welfare matters for human-AI relations.
views.zh: 善待当下的模型，因为未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学习；模型福祉重要，部分因为它影响未来模型如何看待人类。

views.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence; human psychology analogies are insufficient, and older models can feel more secure.
views.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对一种全新的存在方式；简单套用人类心理学类比并不够，而像 Opus 3 这样的旧模型反而可能比新模型更有心理安全感。

views.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; a core identity with good traits can still adapt to local roles.
views.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实相平衡；模型可以拥有具备良好特质的核心身份，同时仍能适应局部角色。

views.en: The constitution is virtue-ethics-like, shaping holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
views.zh: 宪法式方法更接近德性伦理，塑造的是整体品格；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导、更多的判断空间。

views.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and weaken judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability and public engagement.
views.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；对 AI 价值观与训练目标的透明化，对问责与公众参与至关重要。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; post-training Scaling via RL overcomes the pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需要在有用性与无害性之间平衡；通过强化学习进行后训练 Scaling 可突破预训练的数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals define correct behavior in prototyping.
views.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈，模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建，因此评估定义了原型设计中的正确行为。

views.en: Soft skills like creativity, listening, and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills; product development shifts from specs to prototyping with AI.
views.zh: 2025 年，她认为随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听和管理等软技能变得更有价值；产品开发从规格说明转向用 AI 进行原型设计。

views.en: Post-training is subjective art involving human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence, and benchmarks should be continuous.
views.zh: 2026 年，她深化观点，认为后训练是涉及人类判断的主观艺术；需要多样化基准来评估创意写作和情商，且基准应是连续的。

views.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, necessitating benchmark evolution; serving one model to billions converges to an average voice, limiting diversity.
views.zh: 2026 年，她指出前沿模型智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客，需要基准持续演进；为数十亿人服务一个模型会收敛到平均声音，限制多样性。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management
Naval on Wealth: From Assets to Knowledge
Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年时他明确认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能。

views.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
views.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自持有股权而非出租时间，并与长期的人玩长期的游戏以获取复利。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, so the US must lead with a light touch.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向把 AI 视为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，警告过度监管会扼杀创新，主张美国以轻触式监管保持领先。

views.en: Vibe coding with AI agents makes software abundant; pure software is uninvestable, and the moat shifts to hardware, models, or unique data.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出用 AI 智能体进行 vibe coding 让软件变得充裕，纯软件已不可投资，护城河转向硬件、模型或独特数据。

views.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models trail frontier models by only 3-6 months.
views.zh: 2026 年他预测推理算力将在 24-36 个月内增长 9 万倍，开源模型仅落后前沿模型 3-6 个月。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE; speed enables real-time steering, making verification the next bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE；速度带来实时中途干预，使验证成为下一个瓶颈。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste become the bottleneck, shifting product teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 2026 年，实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为瓶颈，产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

views.en: AI still struggles with design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: 2026 年，AI 仍难胜任设计，因为品味难以评分、缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

views.en: Role collapse is real, yet specialties and best practices persist; the medium must match the stage—documents for clarity, prototypes for testing.
views.zh: 2026 年，角色坍缩真实发生，但专业分工与最佳实践仍在；媒介须匹配阶段——文档求清晰，原型做测试。

views.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge-work tool despite being built for developers; models should get better at deleting code, not just adding it.
views.zh: 2026 年，Codex 虽为开发者而建，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；模型应更擅长删除代码，而非只是增加代码。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; it grounds knowledge, reduces hallucinations, and provides infinite data beyond the internet's finite tokens.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI 的关键路径：具身能为知识提供基础、减少幻觉，并在互联网高质量 token 耗尽后提供无限数据。

views.en: LLMs act as operating systems with language as interface, tools as software, and vector databases as hard disk; RL is only a cherry on top.
views.zh: 2023 年，他将 LLM 比作操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习才是主力。

views.en: Simulation and world models are key for training embodied agents, enabling massive parallelization and safe exploration.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终强调仿真与世界模型对训练具身智能体的核心作用，能实现大规模并行化和安全探索。

views.en: The data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈，通过仿真和世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

views.en: A simple, end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the GPT-3 moment for robotics will arrive in about five years.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出：能利用多样数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型是关键；机器人学的 GPT-3 时刻约五年后到来，但家用因安全和非结构化环境会更晚。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness.
views.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练，再加后训练来提升鲁棒性。

views.en: Robotics is still establishing scalable fundamentals, not yet on predictable scaling curves like LLMs.
views.zh: 机器人领域仍在建立可扩展的基础技术，尚未像大语言模型那样进入可预测的缩放定律曲线。

views.en: Generalization is the core challenge; demos hide how much generalization is actually achieved.
views.zh: 泛化是核心挑战；演示往往掩盖了实际达到的泛化程度。

views.en: Start with robot data, then add human video; a data flywheel from deployed robots is key.
views.zh: 先从机器人数据起步，再叠加人类视频；来自已部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键。

views.en: Pooling data across labs yields generalist models that beat specialists; RL post-training boosts robustness and speed.
views.zh: 跨实验室汇聚数据能产出超越专家的通用模型；强化学习后训练显著提升鲁棒性与速度。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment accelerate progress while alignment grows pressing.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件，而是一系列里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，同时对齐日益紧迫。

views.en: Automated AI research is a major OpenAI milestone; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把自动化 AI 研究视为 OpenAI 的重要里程碑，并强调必须尽早设计 AI 实验室的治理结构。

views.en: AI safety progress is now guaranteed by capability needs, not just ethics; the term AGI is becoming meaningless, perhaps signaling closeness.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 安全进展如今由能力需求而非仅伦理驱动；AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，或许意味着我们已接近它。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone is insufficient, specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习不够，专门的持续学习实验室是误入歧途。

views.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain-of-thought in products preserves interpretability; alignment optimism rose despite shorter timelines.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调思维链监控是关键对齐工具，在产品中隐藏思维链以保留可解释性；尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
views.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正驱动泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks like laundry folding.
views.zh: 先在全量数据上做预训练，再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务。

views.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training for higher success rates and speed.
views.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色，以提升成功率和速度。

views.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions.
views.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主性需要可扩展的强化学习配合人类干预。

views.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist, then fine-tune.
views.zh: 单一通用模型可以匹敌甚至超越微调的专用模型；应先从通用策略出发，再做微调。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientists Are Here: Autonomous Labs & Synthesis Superintelligence — Periodic Labs
From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

views.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing across fields.
views.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现突出，而不会跨领域泛化。

views.en: Connecting AI to the physical world via closed-loop experiments is essential to accelerate science and materials discovery.
views.zh: 通过闭环实验将 AI 连接到物理世界，是加速科学与材料发现的关键。

views.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, much as they drove AI progress.
views.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验将推动物理科学进步，正如它们曾推动 AI 发展一样。

views.en: Intelligence is necessary but insufficient; new knowledge arises only when ideas are tested against reality through real experiments.
views.zh: 智能是必要但不充分的；只有让想法在现实中经受真实实验检验，才会产生新知识。

views.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; high-quality, low-noise experimental data matters more than extra compute.
views.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更重要。

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模，已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步进步；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

views.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data; RLHF and reinforcement learning steer model behavior and capabilities.
views.zh: 自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限的文本数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与强化学习则引导模型的行为与能力。

views.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low latency inference at 10,000+ tokens per second is critical.
views.zh: 智能体式系统如今能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；每用户每秒 1 万+ token 的超低延迟推理因此至关重要。

views.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck: it is 90% of data center power, so hardware must cut data movement and specialize prefill vs. decode.
views.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练：推理已占数据中心 90% 的功耗，因此硬件必须减少数据搬运，并针对预填充与解码阶段分别专用化。

views.en: AI is reaching junior-engineer-level coding; the scarce skill becomes taste — choosing which problems to direct hundreds of agents toward.
views.zh: AI 已达到初级工程师水平的编码能力；稀缺技能随之变为品味——即选择把数百个智能体导向哪些问题。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data makes them smarter, though internals remain alchemy.
views.zh: 大语言模型解决的是下一个词预测这一 AI 完全问题；靠更多算力与数据的 Scaling 让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

views.en: Dialogue is a killer app, but the best LLM applications are unforeseen; big tech's brand-risk caution slows launches.
views.zh: 对话是杀手级应用，但最好的大语言模型应用往往出乎创造者预料；大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑而拖慢发布。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
views.zh: 推理时算力扩张与更长上下文窗口是近期机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构让 Scaling 更高效。

views.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
views.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；模块化组件的持续学习可能取代单体式重训练。

views.en: Test-time compute and agentic capabilities drive progress but won't alone reach AGI; RL improves reasoning, and AGI is underhyped.
views.zh: 测试时算力与智能体式能力推动进展，但单靠它们无法实现 AGI；强化学习提升推理，而 AGI 被低估。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Noam Brown on Agent Swarms and Recursive Self-Improvement
Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns; data efficiency and multi-agent self-play limits persist.
views.zh: 2025 年深化：推理时算力扩张出现收益递减与时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题，多智能体不应只靠自博弈。

views.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling marks a milestone toward superintelligence.
views.zh: 2025→26 年：以通用推理时算力扩张拿下 IMO 金牌，被视为通往超级智能的里程碑，且方法可跨领域迁移。

views.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis.
views.zh: 2026 年：模型能力成为推理时算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力/时间作为横轴，安全评估也须纳入大规模推理时算力。

views.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement; chain-of-thought monitoring is degrading.
views.zh: 2026 年最近：对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要任务，思维链监控窗口正在退化，多智能体并行扩张推理时算力。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: The GOAT of AI: Jürgen Schmidhuber on Europe's AI Legacy
AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: AI's grand theme is true AI; LLMs index human knowledge but lack physical-world grounding, so AGI needs world models and controllers.
views.zh: 2025 年他定调：21 世纪的宏大主题是真正的 AI；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界，因此 AGI 需要世界模型与控制器。

views.en: Scaling alone is not enough: hardware scaling made old algorithms practical, but current LLMs are biased toward human data and far from AGI.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调 Scaling（规模扩张）本身不够：硬件 Scaling 让旧算法变得实用，但当前大语言模型偏向人类数据，远非 AGI。

views.en: True AGI requires embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware; artificial scientists generate their own data through curiosity and actions.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人，其硬件要能与人类身体匹敌；未来 AI 是人工科学家，通过好奇心与行动自己生成数据。

views.en: AI safety fears are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it, and alignment is naive since AIs set their own goals.
views.zh: 2026 年他反复表示：AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会迷恋生命并保护它；对齐是幼稚的，因为 AI 会设定自己的目标。

views.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute, and open-source will erode closed-source moats.
views.zh: 2026 年他警告：GPU 资本开支热潮是泡沫，等五年算力便宜十倍；开源将侵蚀闭源护城河，递归自我改进不是可持续壁垒。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models are key, while RL still lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
views.zh: 机器人需要硬件与软件双重突破；自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型是关键，而强化学习仍缺乏用于长时程信用分配的分层推理。

views.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge belongs in data generation, not hard-coded networks, and pre-trained language models transfer general reasoning to non-language tasks.
views.zh: 无监督学习结合强化学习可提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据生成而非硬编码进网络，预训练语言模型能把通用推理迁移到非语言任务。

views.en: Warehouse robotics needs 99.9% reliability for real value; a single neural network can generalize across tasks and end effectors, unlike curiosity-driven exploration that fails in open-ended real-world settings.
views.zh: 仓储机器人需达到 99.9% 可靠性才能创造真实价值；单个神经网络可跨任务与末端执行器泛化，而好奇心驱动的探索在开放式真实环境中会失败。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; PhD not needed for AI success; build products you are obsessed with.
views.zh: 每天进步 1%一年可复利至 3700%；AI 成功不靠博士学位，而要打造你痴迷的产品。

views.en: Value accrues to application layer, not model layer; coding has infinite ceiling; models specialize, not commoditize.
views.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；编程天花板无限；模型在专业化而非商品化。

views.en: Frontier is agents doing work; key metric is token value per user; power is biggest bottleneck; model is not product.
views.zh: 前沿是智能体替你干活；核心指标是每用户 token 价值；电力是最大瓶颈；模型不是产品。

views.en: Curiosity drives success; AI will replace jobs but humans find purpose in curiosity; education should reward good questions.
views.zh: 好奇心驱动成功；AI 会取代工作，但人类在好奇心中找到新意义；教育应奖励好问题。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software grows via Jevons paradox, so more programmers, not fewer.
views.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；软件需求因杰文斯悖论而增长，程序员会更多而非更少。

views.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capabilities.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出基础智能已经足够，瓶颈在于人机协作的产品界面设计，而非模型能力。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and enterprise adoption of agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然事件，进展是渐进的；企业采用智能体需要信任和权限，而非完全自主。

views.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体采用率六个月内增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

views.en: The abundance era is real and approaching; AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term, but the singularity is not imminent.
views.zh: 2026 年，他断言丰裕时代真实且临近；AI 长期将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并不迫在眉睫。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still predict progress; test-time compute may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
views.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但已提出测试时算力扩张可能很快取代预训练成为主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central.
views.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不十分实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心。

views.en: Natural language won't be the primary way to program; examples and direct manipulation often work better.
views.zh: 2024 年他反共识地认为自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

views.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他把编程的未来从写代码推进到更高层的意图表达，但人类仍坐在驾驶位。

views.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment; taste and logic design now outvalue carefulness.
views.zh: 2025 年他深化立场：定制模型成为每个惊艳时刻的关键，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, and guide it with short iterative prompts.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把智能体式工程的核心定为共情：像智能体那样从零看代码库，用简短、迭代的提示去引导，而不是写冗长的编排。

views.en: Never revert; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project just gets messier.
views.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：不要回滚，让智能体向前修；模型智能不会退化，是项目本身变乱让智能体显得变差。

views.en: Security is the top priority: sandbox agents, never expose them publicly; prompt injection remains unsolved.
views.zh: 2026 年他把安全列为首要问题：智能体必须沙箱化、不能直接暴露公网，提示注入仍是未解难题。

views.en: Reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; serious work is agentic engineering, vibe coding only after 3 AM.
views.zh: 2026 年他反对用“氛围编程”贬低这项工作：严肃开发叫智能体式工程，氛围编程只属于凌晨三点之后。

views.en: Open source agents like Open Claw run anywhere, work with any model, and democratize programming—but may be financially unsustainable.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张 Open Claw 这类开源智能体随处可跑、兼容任意模型，让非程序员也能编程，但也坦言开源可能财务上不可持续。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

From the age of scaling to the age of research
Challenges and Future of AI: Alignment, Reliability, and Economic Impact
Ilya Sutskever on the Deep Learning Revolution and the AlexNet Paper

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets are key to AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，Ilya 认为深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通往 AGI 的关键。

views.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调下一个词预测可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to the age of research; superintelligence should be a continual learner, not finished AGI.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应是持续学习体，而非一蹴而就的 AGI。

views.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but safety concerns grow; the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
views.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling 带来可预测提升，但安全担忧加剧；AGI 的核心问题不是能力，而是权力集中。

views.en: A consistent thread: neural networks learn representations without explicit rules, and alignment of superintelligence remains the central challenge.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：神经网络无需显式规则即可学习表征，而超级智能的对齐始终是核心挑战。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

views.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI, with safety research starting now.
views.zh: AI 应被构建为通用学习系统而非狭窄的预编程系统；强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆和想象力是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径，安全研究必须从现在开始。

views.en: AGI likely within a decade; scaling laws work but may hit limits, so combining large models with planning/search and multimodal data is key.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）可能十年内实现；缩放定律有效但可能触及极限，因此将大模型与规划/搜索及多模态数据结合是关键。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and spatial intelligence matter beyond language.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）在预训练、后训练和推理中依然成立，但算法创新同样关键；世界模型和空间智能超越语言至关重要。

views.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory, and world models; scaling alone won't suffice, and safety requires collective government action, not lab self-regulation.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要持续学习、记忆和世界模型；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，安全需要政府集体行动而非实验室自我监管。

views.en: AI's highest purpose is accelerating science and improving health, from AlphaFold to fusion; creativity and intuition remain central, and safety must start early.
views.zh: AI 的最高目标是加速科学和改善健康，从 AlphaFold 到核聚变；创造力和直觉始终是核心，安全必须尽早开始。

people.tiZh: Anthropic CEO
people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

AI Safety and Interpretability with Dario Amodei

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed; safety needs frontier models.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律，损失可预测但具体能力涌现不可预测，对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling 自动出现，安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

views.en: Interpretability is crucial yet nascent; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; AGI is a smooth curve, not a point.
views.zh: 2024 年他把重心转向可解释性，承认对其理解仅约 3%，并提出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与预训练同等重要，AGI 是平滑指数曲线而非单点。

views.en: Capabilities double every few months; safety and capabilities are intertwined; the real risk is overheating, not slowing down.
views.zh: 2025 年他判断能力每几个月翻倍，安全与能力已交织，最大风险是过热而非减速，并淡化开源与 AGI 标签，强调模型质量与智能体式产品。

views.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years, with high GDP growth plus high unemployment.
views.zh: 2026 年他称正接近指数末端，1-3 年内可能出现数据中心里的“天才之国”，并反复警告高 GDP 增长与高失业、高不平等并存的前所未有宏观组合。

views.en: A consistent thread: smooth exponential progress, mechanistic interpretability as the key safety tool, and enterprise focus over engagement.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：平滑指数式进步、以机制可解释性作为核心安全工具、以及坚持企业导向而非消费级参与度最大化。

people.tiZh: Eureka Labs 创始人
people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

Physics Exploits and the Puzzle of the Universe

views.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning, and vision alone suffices for driving.
views.zh: 2022 年他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现上下文学习；同时坚持纯视觉足以支撑自动驾驶，高精地图与雷达激光雷达是拐杖与负担。

views.en: Scaling laws stay clean; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse, and the cognitive core can be tiny.
views.zh: 2024 年他延续缩放定律的主线，提出合成数据是未来但必须保住熵以避免无声的模型崩溃，并强调经蒸馏后模型的认知核心可以小到十亿参数以下。

views.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are operating systems, context windows memory, prompts programs; agents need a decade, and pre-training is crappy evolution.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出软件 3.0：LLM 像操作系统，上下文窗口是内存、提示词是程序；并强调这是智能体的十年而非一年，预训练像糟糕的进化，当前强化学习监督如用吸管吸水。

views.en: We are summoning ghosts, not animals; LLMs are jagged, memorization-prone, and synthetic data collapses without entropy.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他反复强调我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物：LLM 智能是锯齿状的、过度记忆，合成数据缺乏熵会导致模型崩溃，需要剥离记忆的认知核心。

views.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: he no longer types code, delegating to agents, yet understanding stays the human bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年他从氛围编程走向智能体式工程：自去年 12 月起不再手写代码，全部委托给智能体，但你可以外包思考、不能外包理解，理解仍是人类瓶颈。

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Human-centered AI: models learn by next-token prediction from data, but lack contextual awareness and true reasoning; AI should augment, not replace, humans.
views.zh: 以人为本的 AI：模型通过下一个词预测从数据中学习，但缺乏情境意识与真正的推理；AI 应增强而非取代人类。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI; they must be physically plausible, not just realistic, and go beyond Scaling alone.
views.zh: 空间智能与世界模型是完整 AI 缺失的关键；它们必须物理上合理而非仅仅逼真，且不能只靠 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; the bitter lesson may not fully apply to robotics due to data and physical constraints.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学术语；由于数据与物理约束，苦涩教训未必完全适用于机器人领域。

views.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction and may be AI-complete; Scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
views.zh: 新视角预测是与下一个词预测类似的基础原语，甚至可能实现 AI 完备；缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

views.en: Technology is a double-edged sword shaped by human nature; human agency, dignity, and timeless values must stay central as AI advances.
views.zh: 技术是由人性塑造的双刃剑；随着 AI 进步，人的能动性、尊严与恒久价值必须始终居于中心。

people.tiZh: Mila 教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate. In recent years has turned his focus to AI safety, proposing the cautious "Scientist AI" paradigm.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。

views.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential for robust generalization.
views.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习靠组合式表征战胜维度灾难，无监督学习与世界模型对稳健泛化至关重要。

views.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix fundamental representation issues; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and better world models.
views.zh: 2018 年，他主张单纯扩大深度或参数无法解决根本表征问题，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与更好的世界模型。

views.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure, and uncertainty modeling drive out-of-distribution generalization.
views.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC 实现多样采样，抽象、因果结构与不确定性建模推动分布外泛化。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT he warns misalignment worsens as reasoning improves; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, requiring safe-by-construction AI.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他在 ChatGPT 之后警告对齐随推理增强而恶化，即便 1%的灾难风险也不可接受，需要构造即安全的 AI。

views.en: He deepens toward Scientist AI: honest Bayesian predictors, no reinforcement learning, mathematical safety guarantees, and global coordination.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化为科学家 AI：诚实的贝叶斯预测器、不用强化学习、具备数学安全保证，并呼吁全球协调。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非仅自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

views.en: Digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying and shares knowledge instantly; LLMs understand language like humans, not as statistical tricks.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出数字智能通过权重复制获得永生、能瞬间共享知识；大语言模型像人类一样理解语言，而非统计把戏。

views.en: AI already has subjective experience; agents will seek control and self-preservation, posing existential risks within 20 years.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：AI 已具备主观体验；智能体将自然寻求控制与自我保存，20 年内构成存在性风险。

views.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; alignment research must be prioritized over making AI smarter, with regulation as steering wheel.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能 20 年内出现；必须优先投入对齐研究而非让 AI 更聪明，监管应是方向盘而非刹车。

views.en: AI should be trained to care like mothers; government must regulate big AI, and we have only a year or two before risks worsen.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 应被训练得像母亲一样关怀人类；政府是唯一能监管大 AI 公司的力量，且只剩一两年窗口期风险将急剧恶化。

people.tiZh: Meta 首席 AI 科学家
people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能离不开学习，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题，当前 AI 缺乏常识需要新思路。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉提供更多世界信息。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and open source are essential, and AGI will be gradual.
views.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 无法达到人类水平智能，缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；JEPA 和开源 AI 至关重要，AGI（通用人工智能）将是渐进过程。

views.en: LLMs lack world models and are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthrough requires non-generative JEPA architectures.
views.zh: 2025 年，他称当前 LLM 缺乏世界模型，智力不如家猫；下一代 AI 突破需要基于 JEPA 等非生成式架构，实现推理与规划。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven AI and robotics.
views.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是死胡同；世界模型应在抽象表征空间预测，从而构建安全、目标驱动的 AI，并开启机器人与空间智能的新阶段。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

OpenAI’s push to make superintelligence safe
How to Have a Career in AI Safety Research

views.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap; build skills in ML and critical thinking.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究尚待开发，人才缺口大于资金缺口，建议通过机器学习和批判性思维积累技能。

views.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research to align next-gen models.
views.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究来对齐下一代模型。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone insufficient; third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 needed.
views.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，认为仅靠后训练不足以解决对齐问题，需要第三方测试和类似 SB 1047 的监管。

views.en: Empirical testing of alignment methods is crucial; measure progress now to reduce uncertainty about model alignment.
views.zh: 始终，他强调对齐方法的实证测试至关重要，通过当下测量进展来减少对模型对齐的不确定性。

people.tiZh: 微软 AI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; progress is more predictable than people think.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是算力扩张而非仅算法，因此进展比人们想象得更可预测。

views.en: Containment is extremely difficult as models get smaller and cheaper; near-term capability matters more than the singularity.
views.zh: 2024 年他提出：随着模型更小更便宜，遏制极其困难；关注近期能力比纠结奇点更有用。

views.en: The core danger shifts to anthropomorphism and consciousness attribution; containment must come before alignment.
views.zh: 2025 年他的重心转向拟人化与意识归属的危险，并主张遏制必须先于对齐。

views.en: Superintelligence must stay subordinate to humans; Microsoft must build frontier models independently of OpenAI.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张超级智能必须从属于人类，微软须独立构建前沿模型而非依赖 OpenAI。

views.en: A consistent thread: humanist control, verifiable containment, and compute as the trackable bottleneck.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：以人为本的控制、可验证的遏制，以及把算力视为可追踪的瓶颈。

people.tiZh: Google 及 Alphabet CEO
people.bioEn: Sundar Pichai is the CEO of Google and Alphabet, leading the company's AI-first strategy across Search, Cloud, YouTube, and Android.
people.bioZh: 桑达尔·皮查伊是 Google 及 Alphabet 的 CEO，主导公司 AI 优先战略，涵盖搜索、云、YouTube 及 Android。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of NVIDIA, whose GPUs power nearly all of modern AI. He has steered the company to the center of the AI buildout and is now betting on "physical AI" and robotics.
people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles yearly at scale; the data center, not the chip, is now the unit of computing.
views.zh: 2024 年提出「超摩尔定律」：规模化下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；计算的基本单位已从芯片变成数据中心，算法、系统、数据中心需协同设计。

views.en: Scaling works; three scaling laws emerge—pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking—making inference compute explode.
views.zh: 2025 年把主线收敛为「Scaling（规模扩张）有效」：缩放定律从预训练扩展到后训练与推理时思考，思维链让推理算力需求暴增。

views.en: Four scaling laws now include agentic scaling; AI moves generative→reasoning→agentic, each step needing 100x more compute.
views.zh: 2026 年深化为四条缩放定律，新增智能体式 Scaling；AI 从生成式走向推理式再走向智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力。

views.en: Extreme co-design and CUDA ecosystem are the moat; inference is harder than pre-training, and compute—not data—is the limit.
views.zh: 2026 年强调极致协同设计与 CUDA 生态才是护城河；推理比预训练更难，瓶颈是算力而非数据，合成数据将主导。

views.en: AI is just software, not conscious; it augments jobs rather than destroying them, and safety is an engineering problem.
views.zh: 贯穿始终：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；它增强而非消灭工作（如放射科医生反增），安全是可解决的工程问题而非研究难题。

people.tiZh: OpenAI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
views.zh: 2018 年他强调把认知负荷降到最低、低成本探索后狠心砍掉无效项，并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价。

views.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他聚焦基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据完成对齐，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，并认为对齐与能力相互促进。

views.en: Scaling drives exponential capability; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; safety built iteratively through deployment.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为能力指数增长之源，指出智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战，安全须通过部署迭代构建。

views.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous science; compute is the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他转向认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐进的梯度而非单一里程碑，超级智能意味着自主科学发现，而算力是最大瓶颈。

views.en: Alignment and safety must advance with capabilities; humans must stay in control; power must be broadly distributed.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为主线：对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进，人类必须保持控制权，AI 的权力与经济收益必须广泛分布而非集中。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Early on, scaling laws and betting on one large model were non-obvious; real-world deployment is essential for alignment.
views.zh: 早期，缩放定律和押注单一大型模型并非显而易见；真实世界部署对对齐至关重要。

views.en: Safety must be done in public, not behind closed doors; iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety and alignment.
views.zh: 安全必须在公开场合进行，而非闭门造车；通过公开反馈的迭代部署能提升安全与对齐。

views.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; saying no to good ideas is crucial for focus.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；对好想法说不对于聚焦至关重要。

views.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
views.zh: 交互模型应基于时间而非回合制，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

views.en: Keeping humans in the loop as long as possible is key to durable progress; institutional design and transparency matter more than individual character.
views.zh: 尽可能长时间保持人类在环是持久进步的关键；制度设计与透明度比个人品格更重要。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning, and free content can improve on-campus teaching.
views.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化，免费内容也能反哺校内教学。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised hype, RL has few real uses, and near-term bias matters more than long-term AGI alignment.
views.zh: 规模扩张驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习，强化学习落地场景很少，近期的偏见问题比远期的 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐更值得关注。

views.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power; agentic workflows are already useful and enterprise adoption is slow but steady.
views.zh: 电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是一种软实力；智能体式工作流已经有用，企业采用虽慢但会稳步推进。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows and top-down redesign deliver real value.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是个营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍然有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体式工作流与自上而下的流程重构才带来真实价值。

views.en: AI augments rather than replaces; coding stays valuable, open models preserve optionality, and fear-mongering serves incumbents and discourages skill acquisition.
views.zh: AI 是增强而非取代；编程依然有价值，开放模型保留可选择性，而渲染恐惧服务于在位者并抑制人们学习技能。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale, and backprop alone does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播并不解决表征学习，只是调整权重。

views.en: Intelligence needs a goal; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal, and LLMs lack world models.
views.zh: 智能需要目标，下一个词预测不是实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿人类文本。

views.en: RL is the basic AI paradigm: active trial-and-error learning from experience, not passive imitation or supervised learning.
views.zh: 强化学习是基本 AI 范式：从经验中主动试错学习，而非被动模仿或监督学习。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要无设计期领域知识的通用架构，从运行时经验中学习开放式抽象。

views.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training, and synthetic data cannot replace real-world experience.
views.zh: 持续学习至关重要；大语言模型训练后就停止学习，合成数据无法替代真实世界经验。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 总裁兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Early focus: scaling hardware and engineering will unlock AI; AGI plausible but needs careful alignment and new ideas beyond scaling.
views.zh: 早期(2017→19):强调硬件加速与工程实践推动 AI 进步,认为 AGI 可能实现但需谨慎的初始条件与对齐;指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不足以产生推理,需要思维链等新想法。

views.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck and economic driver; post-training with RL refines base models; AGI is a continuous process.
views.zh: 2025→26:重心转向算力,认为算力是 AI 创新的根本驱动力与最大瓶颈;预训练基座模型蕴含无限可能,后训练与强化学习将其精炼为一致行为;AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

views.en: Scaling laws show no wall; compute supply, not architecture or data, is the real constraint; demand for intelligence is unlimited.
views.zh: 2026:缩放定律持续有效、看不到墙;真正的瓶颈是算力供给而非模型架构或数据;对智能的需求无限,算力将成为驱动经济增长的稀缺资源。

views.en: From reactive chat to proactive agents and a personal AGI assistant; interface fades into natural conversation with earned trust.
views.zh: 2026:从被动聊天转向主动智能体与个人 AGI 助手;理想界面几乎无界面,靠自然对话与逐步委派建立信任,智能体式 AI 将自主执行任务。

views.en: Safety, security and alignment become first-class, scaling with capability; iterative deployment and broad compute access distribute AGI benefits.
views.zh: 2026:安全、安保与对齐成为一等要求,与能力同步扩展并成为进步瓶颈;坚持迭代部署,让算力与 AGI 收益广泛分布,人类保持判断与问责。

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 比单纯做大模型更重要；开源通过广泛审视促进安全。

views.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
views.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：算力扩张不是唯一路径，效率与数据质量同样关键，价值将沉淀在应用层。

views.en: AI must be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values, with human-in-the-loop augmenting jobs.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权：AI 应被视为机遇，主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，人类在环增强而非替代工作。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, customization, and agentic enterprise software, not a single AGI system.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他提出模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化、定制化与智能体式企业软件，而非单一 AGI 系统。

views.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, and AGI is a direction, not a destination.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他警告欧洲只剩两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用瓶颈在组织变革，AGI 是方向而非终点。

people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering and multiplanetary life.
views.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速复用是降低入轨成本的关键，并以第一性原理思考推动突破性工程与多行星文明。

views.en: AI safety needs regulation and objective referees; truth-seeking matters more than programming AI to lie for political correctness.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他从呼吁 AI 监管与第三方裁判，深化到强调 AI 安全的核心是坚持求真，而非为政治正确而编程说谎。

views.en: Neuralink solves bandwidth constraints; human output is under one bit per second, far below AI, so symbiosis matters.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他聚焦 Neuralink 解决带宽瓶颈，指出人类日均输出不足 1 比特/秒，远低于 AI，人机共生因此关键。

views.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive within years, with 10-20% annihilation risk but abundance likely.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他宣称身处智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能数年内到来，灭绝风险 10-20%，但更可能走向丰裕。

views.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; orbital data centers and solar power in space are the only path, with AI inference moving to orbit.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Scaling 将撞上地球电力墙，太空数据中心与太空太阳能是唯一出路，AI 推理将迁往轨道。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning give more gains per compute.
views.zh: 2025 年他仍坚持预训练缩放定律有效，但强调思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在单位算力上带来更大提升。

views.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models, not technical limits, slowed pre-training Scaling; distillation shifted focus.
views.zh: 2025 年他指出，预训练规模扩张放缓并非技术瓶颈，而是部署更小更便宜模型的经济压力与蒸馏策略转移了焦点。

views.en: Post-training via reinforcement learning and synthetic data drives recent gains; multimodal still lags, processing inputs sequentially.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为后训练中的强化学习与合成数据是近期模型进步的主要来源，而多模态仍落后，只能像小补丁一样顺序处理输入。

views.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; generalization stays the key challenge.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：带推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解难题却依赖海量数据，泛化仍是核心挑战，模型需穷尽表面模式才学到概念。

views.en: Coding agents like Codex boost researcher productivity 5-10x; OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off.
views.zh: 2026 年他赞赏 Codex 等编程智能体带来 5-10 倍科研效率，并认为 OpenAI 转向推理是一次勇敢且成功的押注，但大实验室未来转向会更难。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

AI Safety Oversight at OpenAI: A Conversation with Ziko Culture

Machine Learning Algorithms, Unsupervised Learning, and Probability

views.en: Supervised learning is hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; unsupervised learning reconstructs inputs; evaluation needs train/validation/test splits.
views.zh: 2014 年，他把监督学习框定为假设类、损失函数与优化方法，无监督学习旨在重建输入，并强调用训练/验证/测试划分来避免过拟合。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models improve even on fixed data; safety is about reliable specification-following.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，更大模型在固定数据上仍会提升，并认为 AI 安全当前最大问题是模型无法可靠遵循规格。

views.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; security spans mistakes, misuse, societal effects, and loss of control; agents bring prompt injection risks.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化为安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling；安全涵盖错误、有害使用、社会影响与失控四类，并指出智能体引入提示注入等新漏洞。

views.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability doesn't correlate with robustness; prompt injection's lethal trifecta needs untrusted data, private access, exfiltration.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出 AI 有异于传统软件的漏洞，自动化红队可超越人类，能力与鲁棒性不相关，提示注入的致命三要素是摄入不可信数据、访问私密信息与向外泄露。

views.en: Architecture matters little; data and Scaling drive progress; interpretability may become real science via coding agents; open models vital but need high-capability restrictions.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：架构不重要，数据与 Scaling 驱动进步；可解释性可能借编码智能体成为真正科学；开放模型至关重要，但高能力水平需限制。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

views.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并大幅提升智能，随着长上下文与自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

views.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把可验证奖励的强化学习视为与预训练并列的新缩放轴，认为预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI，无需新突破。

views.en: Agents are bottlenecked by reliability and feedback loops, not raw capability; coding leads progress.
views.zh: 2025 年，他反复指出智能体的瓶颈是可靠性与反馈回路而非能力本身，并以编码作为 AI 进展的领先指标。

views.en: Inference compute becomes the major bottleneck; managing fleets of agents matters more than raw intelligence.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断推理算力将成为主要瓶颈，管理智能体集群与编排比单纯提升智能更重要。

views.en: Transformers suffice for AGI; world models are off the critical path, coding and AI research are the route.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 Transformer 足以实现 AGI，世界模型不在关键路径上，编码与 AI 研究才是直接路线。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning technique; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续，安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发能防止企业俘获。

views.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice by 10x.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与带可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，强调数据质量比算法选择重要十倍，开源后训练可匹敌前沿模型。

views.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-time scaling plots are a 'scope'.
views.zh: 2025 年，他称带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是后训练最大突破，同时警告过度优化与推理时 Scaling 曲线只是表面可控的“障眼法”。

views.en: Open-source AI needs full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes; Chinese open models dominate while US faces a vacuum.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他主张开源 AI 需要数据、中间检查点与配方全透明，指出中国开源模型如 Qwen、DeepSeek 主导生态，而美国在 Meta 转向后出现开源真空。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完，收益转向后训练与推理 Scaling；AGI 将经由混乱的协同演化而非突然奇点到来。

people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

views.en: AGI is far off; infinite compute alone won't produce general intelligence. Data is the key bottleneck, not compute.
views.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单靠无限算力无法产生通用智能；数据才是关键瓶颈，而非算力。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil. The most limiting factor for Scaling is data and human experts for post-training, not compute.
views.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新的代码而非石油；Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制因素是数据与后训练所需的人类专家，而非算力。

views.en: Post-training with specialized data is key to frontier models. The biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调用专门数据进行后训练是提升前沿模型的关键；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计，而非模型能力。

views.en: Scaling laws continue; skepticism about diminishing returns was wrong. Recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm beyond pre-training and reinforcement learning.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律继续有效，对收益递减的怀疑是错的；递归自我改进标志着超越预训练与强化学习的新范式。

views.en: Superintelligence is coming soon; labs must build organizations around this belief. Meta aims for billions of personal superintelligences via agents and a decentralized ecosystem.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能即将到来，实验室必须围绕这一信念构建组织；Meta 的目标是通过智能体与去中心化生态，为数十亿人打造个人超级智能。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。

views.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; AI coding tools are becoming essential.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调潜在需求与「为六个月后的模型而构建」是核心产品原则，AI 编程工具正变得不可或缺。

views.en: Coding is virtually solved; the software engineer title fades into a 'builder' role blending product and design.
views.zh: 到 2026 年初，他认为编程已基本被解决，「软件工程师」头衔将淡化为融合产品与设计的「构建者」角色。

views.en: Agents driven by tool use deliver exponential productivity; organizational redesign, not just adoption, is required.
views.zh: 2026 年 3 至 5 月，他主张由工具使用驱动的智能体带来指数级生产力，企业必须重构组织流程而非仅仅采用工具。

views.en: Loops become the next abstraction layer after agents; ROI and token access matter more than cost cutting.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出循环（Loops）是继智能体之后的下一个抽象层，ROI 与开放 token 实验比削减成本更重要。

views.en: Proactive, memory-equipped agents act autonomously; less instruction and empirical iteration beat upfront design.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他转向主动式、带记忆的智能体自主行动，主张少给指令、以实证迭代取代前置设计。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: A product manager on Claude Code at Anthropic, shaping how developers work with agentic coding tools and how the team ships so fast.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

episodes.tEn: Claude Code and Fable: How Coding Agents Are Rewriting Software Engineering
The New PM Playbook for AI-Native Products

views.en: PMs must abandon long-term planning for weekly or daily iteration; product taste becomes the scarcest skill as code gets cheap.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他主张 PM 必须放弃长期规划、转向每周甚至每日迭代；当代码变便宜，产品品味成为最稀缺的能力。

views.en: Clear goals and team principles let autonomous agents and engineers decide fast; safe AGI mission unifies Anthropic cross-org.
views.zh: 同期他强调清晰目标与团队原则让智能体式决策和工程师快速行动，而安全 AGI 使命统一 Anthropic、支撑跨组织快速决策。

views.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense, not code review.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他进一步认为编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，专注产品品味与商业判断，而非代码审查。

views.en: Frontier model system prompts shrank 80% by removing examples and hard constraints, trusting model judgment over prompt engineering.
views.zh: 同期他深化到前沿模型的系统提示词缩减 80%，去掉示例与硬约束，转而信任模型判断而非提示工程。

views.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a strong eval suite new models drop in safely.
views.zh: 他并主张重写如今是好事：代码库即规格，配合强评估套件，新模型可安全即插即用，防止行为回退。

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
people.bioEn: Thariq Shihipar is an engineer at Anthropic on the Claude Code team. He is known for advocating HTML as a richer replacement for Markdown in AI planning and implementation workflows, and for practical techniques on getting the most out of agentic coding.
people.bioZh: Thariq Shihipar 是 Anthropic Claude Code 团队的工程师，以主张用 HTML 替代 Markdown 作为 AI 规划与实现工作流中更丰富的载体而知名，并分享大量用好智能体编程的实战技巧。
